title: Can you solve the virus riddle? - Lisa Winer
speaker: TED-Ed
zh: 【TED-Ed】你能解開病毒之謎嗎？ - 麗莎·維納（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Your research team has found a prehistoric virus preserved in the permafrost
cues.en: Your research team has found a prehistoric virus preserved in the permafrost
cues.zh: 你的研究團隊 在永凍層發現了史前病毒 並將它隔離研究

cues.text: and isolated it for study.
cues.en: and isolated it for study.
cues.zh: 並將它隔離研究

cues.text: After a late night working, you're just closing up the lab when a sudden earthquake hits
cues.en: After a late night working, you're just closing up the lab when a sudden earthquake hits
cues.zh: 深夜，在結束工作後 你關上實驗室，一場突然的地震 震斷了電源系統

cues.text: and knocks out the power.
cues.en: and knocks out the power.
cues.zh: 震斷了電源系統 隨即，緊急電源啟動了

cues.text: As the emergency generators kick in, an alarm confirms your worst fears:
cues.en: As the emergency generators kick in, an alarm confirms your worst fears:
cues.zh: 隨即，緊急電源啟動了 但警報聲通知你最害怕的事情： 所有的試樣瓶已經碎裂

cues.text: all the sample vials have broken.
cues.en: all the sample vials have broken.
cues.zh: 所有的試樣瓶已經碎裂 病毒仍在實驗室裡

cues.text: The virus is contained for now, but unless you can destroy it,
cues.en: The virus is contained for now, but unless you can destroy it,
cues.zh: 病毒仍在實驗室裡 但是，除非你能摧毀它

cues.text: the vents will soon open and unleash a deadly airborne plague.
cues.en: the vents will soon open and unleash a deadly airborne plague.
cues.zh: 通風口很快就會開啟 在空氣中釋放致命的瘟疫 你沒有猶豫，穿起了化學防護衣

cues.text: Without hesitation, you grab your HazMat suit and get ready to save the world.
cues.en: Without hesitation, you grab your HazMat suit and get ready to save the world.
cues.zh: 你沒有猶豫，穿起了化學防護衣 準備拯救世界 實驗室由四乘四，共十六間房間組成

cues.text: The lab is a four by four compound of 16 rooms
cues.en: The lab is a four by four compound of 16 rooms
cues.zh: 實驗室由四乘四，共十六間房間組成

cues.text: with an entrance on the northwest corner and an exit at the southeast.
cues.en: with an entrance on the northwest corner and an exit at the southeast.
cues.zh: 實驗室由四乘四，共十六間房間組成 入口在西北角，出口則在東南角 每個房間都有氣閘通往另一個房間

cues.text: Each room is connected to the adjacent ones by an airlock, and the virus has been released in every room except the entrance.
cues.en: Each room is connected to the adjacent ones by an airlock, and the virus has been released in every room except the entrance.
cues.zh: 每個房間都有氣閘通往另一個房間 除了入口那間，病毒已經擴散至 其他所有的房間 要摧毀它 你得進入每個被汙染的房間

cues.text: To destroy it, you must enter each contaminated room and pull its emergency self-destruct switch.
cues.en: To destroy it, you must enter each contaminated room and pull its emergency self-destruct switch.
cues.zh: 要摧毀它 你得進入每個被汙染的房間 拉下緊急自毀開關

cues.text: But there's a catch.
cues.en: But there's a catch.
cues.zh: 但是，有一個問題

cues.text: Because the security system is on lockdown, once you enter the contaminated room,
cues.en: Because the security system is on lockdown, once you enter the contaminated room,
cues.zh: 因為保安系統是上鎖的 一旦你進入被汙染的房間

cues.text: you can't exit without activating the switch, and once you've done so,
cues.en: you can't exit without activating the switch, and once you've done so,
cues.zh: 一旦你進入被汙染的房間 除非啟動開關，否則你無法離開 而且一旦啟動

cues.text: you won't be able to go back in to that room.
cues.en: you won't be able to go back in to that room.
cues.zh: 你就無法再回到那個房間 你開始在一沓紙張上繪製可能的路線

cues.text: You start to draw out possible routes on a pad of paper,
cues.en: You start to draw out possible routes on a pad of paper,
cues.zh: 你開始在一沓紙張上繪製可能的路線 但似乎沒有辦法走到出口

cues.text: but nothing seems to get you to the exit without missing at least one room.
cues.en: but nothing seems to get you to the exit without missing at least one room.
cues.zh: 但似乎沒有辦法走到出口 且不遺漏任何房間 所以，你要如何摧毀所有的病毒

cues.text: So how can you destroy the virus in every contaminated room
cues.en: So how can you destroy the virus in every contaminated room
cues.zh: 所以，你要如何摧毀所有的病毒 並活下來講述這個故事呢？

cues.text: and survive to tell the story?
cues.en: and survive to tell the story?
cues.zh: 並活下來講述這個故事呢？

cues.text: Pause here if you want to figure it out for yourself.
cues.en: Pause here if you want to figure it out for yourself.
cues.zh: 並活下來講述這個故事呢？ 如果你想自己找出答案 請先暫停一下 3

cues.text: Answer in: 3 Answer in: 2 Answer in: 1
cues.en: Answer in: 3 Answer in: 2 Answer in: 1
cues.zh: 3 2 1 如果你的第一反應是 繪製所有可能的路線

cues.text: If your first instinct is to try to graph your possible moves on a grid,
cues.en: If your first instinct is to try to graph your possible moves on a grid,
cues.zh: 如果你的第一反應是 繪製所有可能的路線

cues.text: you've got the right idea.
cues.en: you've got the right idea.
cues.zh: 你的想法是正確的 這個謎題關係到「哈密頓路徑問題」

cues.text: This puzzle is related to the Hamiltonian path problem named after the 19th century Irish mathematician William Rowan Hamilton.
cues.en: This puzzle is related to the Hamiltonian path problem named after the 19th century Irish mathematician William Rowan Hamilton.
cues.zh: 這個謎題關係到「哈密頓路徑問題」 以 19 世紀愛爾蘭數學家 哈密頓之名來命名

cues.text: The challenge of the path problem is to find whether a given graph has a Hamiltonian path.
cues.en: The challenge of the path problem is to find whether a given graph has a Hamiltonian path.
cues.zh: 以 19 世紀愛爾蘭數學家 哈密頓之名來命名 路徑問題的挑戰是找出 一張特定的圖是否具有哈密頓路徑 這條路線會經過所有的節點 且只經過一次

cues.text: That's a route that visits every point within it exactly once.
cues.en: That's a route that visits every point within it exactly once.
cues.zh: 這條路線會經過所有的節點 且只經過一次

cues.text: This type of problem, classified as NP-complete, is notoriously difficult when the graph is sufficiently large.
cues.en: This type of problem, classified as NP-complete, is notoriously difficult when the graph is sufficiently large.
cues.zh: 這條路線會經過所有的節點 且只經過一次 這型別的問題，被歸類在 「非決定性多項式完全」 當圖夠大時，它會變得非常困難 雖然，任何提出的路線 都可以被輕易地驗證

cues.text: Although any proposed solution can be easily verified,
cues.en: Although any proposed solution can be easily verified,
cues.zh: 雖然，任何提出的路線 都可以被輕易地驗證 我們卻沒有可靠的公式或捷徑 來找出正確的那條

cues.text: we have no reliable formula or shortcut for finding one,
cues.en: we have no reliable formula or shortcut for finding one,
cues.zh: 我們卻沒有可靠的公式或捷徑 來找出正確的那條

cues.text: or determining that one exists.
cues.en: or determining that one exists.
cues.zh: 我們卻沒有可靠的公式或捷徑 來找出正確的那條 或確定它存在 我們甚至不知道

cues.text: And we're not even sure if it's possible for computers to reliably find such solutions, either.
cues.en: And we're not even sure if it's possible for computers to reliably find such solutions, either.
cues.zh: 我們甚至不知道 電腦是否能可靠地找出解決方案 這道謎題在哈米頓路徑問題上 增加了變化

cues.text: This puzzle adds a twist to the Hamiltonian path problem in that you have to start and end at specific points.
cues.en: This puzzle adds a twist to the Hamiltonian path problem in that you have to start and end at specific points.
cues.zh: 這道謎題在哈米頓路徑問題上 增加了變化 你必須由特定的起點前往特定的終點 但在你浪費大量的方格紙前

cues.text: But before you waste a ton of graph paper, you should know that a true Hamiltonian path
cues.en: But before you waste a ton of graph paper, you should know that a true Hamiltonian path
cues.zh: 但在你浪費大量的方格紙前 你要知道，真正的哈密頓路徑

cues.text: isn't possible with these end points.
cues.en: isn't possible with these end points.
cues.zh: 你要知道，真正的哈密頓路徑 是不可能連線這些端點的

cues.text: That's because the rooms form a grid with an even number of rooms on each side.
cues.en: That's because the rooms form a grid with an even number of rooms on each side.
cues.zh: 是不可能連線這些端點的 因為房間所形成的網格 每邊都為偶數個房間

cues.text: In any grid with that configuration, a Hamiltonian path that starts and ends in opposite corners is impossible.
cues.en: In any grid with that configuration, a Hamiltonian path that starts and ends in opposite corners is impossible.
cues.zh: 因為房間所形成的網格 每邊都為偶數個房間 任何這種配置的網格 哈密頓路徑是不可能 從相對的角落開始並結束

cues.text: Here's one way of understanding why.
cues.en: Here's one way of understanding why.
cues.zh: 哈密頓路徑是不可能 從相對的角落開始並結束 原因如下 想像一個正方的棋盤，每邊有偶數格

cues.text: Consider a checkerboard grid with an even number of squares on each side.
cues.en: Consider a checkerboard grid with an even number of squares on each side.
cues.zh: 想像一個正方的棋盤，每邊有偶數格 任一條路徑皆交替地經過黑格及白格

cues.text: Every path through it will alternate black and white.
cues.en: Every path through it will alternate black and white.
cues.zh: 任一條路徑皆交替地經過黑格及白格

cues.text: These grids will all also have an even total number of squares
cues.en: These grids will all also have an even total number of squares
cues.zh: 任一條路徑皆交替地經過黑格及白格 這些正方網格，總共也是偶數個

cues.text: because an even number times and even number is even.
cues.en: because an even number times and even number is even.
cues.zh: 這些正方網格，總共也是偶數個 因為偶數乘偶數仍為偶數

cues.text: So a Hamiltonian path on an even-sided grid that starts on black
cues.en: So a Hamiltonian path on an even-sided grid that starts on black
cues.zh: 因為偶數乘偶數仍為偶數 所以，哈密頓路徑在偶數邊的網格 會從黑格開始，並結束在白格

cues.text: will have to end on white.
cues.en: will have to end on white.
cues.zh: 會從黑格開始，並結束在白格

cues.text: And one that starts on white will have to end on black.
cues.en: And one that starts on white will have to end on black.
cues.zh: 會從黑格開始，並結束在白格 而從白格開始，則會在黑格結束

cues.text: However, in any grid with even numbered sides, opposite corners are the same color,
cues.en: However, in any grid with even numbered sides, opposite corners are the same color,
cues.zh: 而從白格開始，則會在黑格結束 然而，在任何偶數邊的網格中 相對的角都是相同的顏色

cues.text: so it's impossible to start and end a Hamiltonian path on opposite corners.
cues.en: so it's impossible to start and end a Hamiltonian path on opposite corners.
cues.zh: 相對的角都是相同的顏色 所以哈密頓路徑不可能 在相對的角落開始並結束

cues.text: It seems like you're out of luck, unless you look at the rules carefully and notice an important exception.
cues.en: It seems like you're out of luck, unless you look at the rules carefully and notice an important exception.
cues.zh: 所以哈密頓路徑不可能 在相對的角落開始並結束 看似是你不走運了 除非，你有仔細看過規則 且注意到一個例外

cues.text: It's true that once you activate the switch in a contaminated room,
cues.en: It's true that once you activate the switch in a contaminated room,
cues.zh: 除非，你有仔細看過規則 且注意到一個例外 一旦你在受汙染的房間啟動開關

cues.text: it's destroyed and you can never go back.
cues.en: it's destroyed and you can never go back.
cues.zh: 一旦你在受汙染的房間啟動開關 病毒會被摧毀，且你不可能回去

cues.text: But there's one room that wasn't contaminated - the entrance.
cues.en: But there's one room that wasn't contaminated - the entrance.
cues.zh: 病毒會被摧毀，且你不可能回去 但是，有一間未受汙染的房間 入口的那一間 這意味你不需要拉開關就能離開房間

cues.text: This means that you can leave it once without pulling the switch
cues.en: This means that you can leave it once without pulling the switch
cues.zh: 這意味你不需要拉開關就能離開房間

cues.text: and return there when you've destroyed either of these two rooms.
cues.en: and return there when you've destroyed either of these two rooms.
cues.zh: 這意味你不需要拉開關就能離開房間 並在摧毀相鄰的其中一間後回來 角落的房間可能會 在你開啟氣閘時受到汙染

cues.text: The corner room may have been contaminated from the airlock opening, but that's okay
cues.en: The corner room may have been contaminated from the airlock opening, but that's okay
cues.zh: 角落的房間可能會 在你開啟氣閘時受到汙染 但沒有關係 因為你可以在第二次進入時 摧毀入口的那一間

cues.text: because you can destroy the entrance after your second visit.
cues.en: because you can destroy the entrance after your second visit.
cues.zh: 因為你可以在第二次進入時 摧毀入口的那一間

cues.text: That return trip gives you four options for a successful route,
cues.en: That return trip gives you four options for a successful route,
cues.zh: 這個返程能提供你四條成功路線 如果你先摧毀這間 也會有四條成功路線

cues.text: and a similar set of options if you destroyed this room first.
cues.en: and a similar set of options if you destroyed this room first.
cues.zh: 如果你先摧毀這間 也會有四條成功路線 恭喜，你阻止末日瘟疫了

cues.text: Congratulations. You've prevented an epidemic of apocalyptic proportions,
cues.en: Congratulations. You've prevented an epidemic of apocalyptic proportions,
cues.zh: 如果你先摧毀這間 也會有四條成功路線 恭喜，你阻止末日瘟疫了 在這緊張的事件後，你需要休息一會

cues.text: but after such a stressful episode, you need a break.
cues.en: but after such a stressful episode, you need a break.
cues.zh: 在這緊張的事件後，你需要休息一會

cues.text: Maybe you should take up that recent job offer to become a traveling salesman.
cues.en: Maybe you should take up that recent job offer to become a traveling salesman.
cues.zh: 也許你該接受最近那份 旅行推銷員的工作邀約了
